name: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P.
summary: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P., along with its various subsidiaries, is a prominent enterprise based in Kuwait that focuses on establishing and managing universities and colleges, both within Kuwait and internationally. The company segments its operations primarily into Higher Education and "Other Ventures." Beyond its core academic endeavors, Humansoft delivers a diverse range of services. These include computer programming, advertising, publication, and distribution, as well as engaging in the buying and selling of shares and bonds. It also offers various technology, e-commerce, and media-related solutions. In the realm of education, Humansoft provides diploma degrees in fields such as business administration, information technology, and engineering. It develops specialized content-based educational programs and offers extensive learning solutions, including e-learning content for IT, business, desktop applications, and languages, alongside professional certification courses and learning management systems. Furthermore, the company offers expert consulting services for the deployment, hosting, and management of e-learning platforms. The company also plays a role in nurturing nascent educational institutions. It conducts courses focusing on technical, application, and business skills, and implements a cyclical pedagogical syllabus learning system. Additionally, Humansoft assists with career development and job placements, and provides management and training services specifically designed for schools. Founded in 1994, Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P. is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.
